MASTER LANDSCAPE MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT
THIS MASTER LANDSCAPE MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made this ____________ day of ___, 2026, by and between Example Landscape Services, Inc. ("we", "us", "our") and Example Community Association ("you", "your").

1. Services. We will mow, edge, and blow all turf areas weekly. We will prune shrubs quarterly and remove all green waste from the site.
We will provide you a monthly service report listing the work performed.
2. Irrigation. We will inspect the irrigation system monthly and repair minor leaks at no additional cost.
Work Not Included A. Improvements, modifications of existing irrigation uniformity and or distribution to be approved by client.
3. Tree Care – There are multiple examples of trees being allowed to breach the safety height. Tree work is priced separately.
4. Payment. You will pay the monthly fee of $2,400 by the tenth day of each month. Overdue payments will be charged at a rate of 18% per year.
5. Limits. You acknowledge that we are NOT the manufacturer of the installed materials and equipment and that we make no representations or warranties as to the installed materials. We shall not be responsible for any damages other than direct damages caused by us.
6. Breach. If either party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within thirty (30) days after written notice, the other party may terminate this Agreement.
